task_title: Quickstart plugin row reworded hook-scoped: enforcement lives on the engine path
task_criteria: docs/quickstart.md is the changed file: its Hermes-plugin row no longer asserts 'no code path enforces, rejects, or size-limits a command'; the reworded row scopes 'observability-only' to the Hermes hooks and attributes command size / byte-budget enforcement to the engine path (HERMES_TERMINAL_JAIL_MAX_COMMAND_BYTES, enforced at intercept()), consistent with README.md's env-var table ('Read and enforced by the plugin') and quickstart section 3a2. items.detail: Commit 65c50b96 changed exactly docs/quickstart.md (git show --stat: 'docs/quickstart.md | 2 +-'), replacing the old row ('The plugin is observability-only; no code path enforces, rejects, or size-limits a command') with the hook-scoped row now at docs/quickstart.md:23: 'Hook-level command wrapping and limiting: NOT IMPLEMENTED (reserved byte budget)... The Hermes hooks observe... but cannot wrap or size-limit a command... Command size IS enforced on the engine path: HERMES_TERMINAL_JAIL_MAX_COMMAND_BYTES bounds the wrapped command the engine produces, enforced at intercept()'. Fresh proof commands on the changed tree: `python3 scripts/docs-check.py` -> 'docs-check: overall PASS', exit 0; `rg -n 'byte budget reserved' README.md docs/` -> exit 1, zero matches; additionally `rg -n -i 'no code path' README.md docs/` -> exit 1, zero matches. Consistency verified: README.md:515 env-var row says 'Read and enforced by the plugin ... enforced at intercept() (plugin/terminal_jail/interruptor/__init__.py:42)' and names the same refusal reason quoted at quickstart.md:23; quickstart §3a2 (line 259) documents the bridge engine path this enforcement lives on. tests/test_quickstart_doc.py re-run fresh: '8 passed in 0.02s', exit 0; full suite in prior stage: 2227 passed, 15 skipped.

items.criterion: The reworded row's code-level claims are factually accurate against the source: env var name HERMES_TERMINAL_JAIL_MAX_COMMAND_BYTES, enforcement point intercept(), and the refusal reason string all exist exactly as the row states.
items.detail: plugin/terminal_jail/plugin.py:238 _max_command_bytes_from_environment() parses 'HERMES_TERMINAL_JAIL_MAX_COMMAND_BYTES' (default 131072, plugin.py:231); plugin/terminal_jail/interruptor/__init__.py:42 defines intercept(), which at :117 calls _record_wrap(result.modified, ...) and at :119-122 returns reason 'Auto-sandbox skipped: wrapped command exceeds the configured byte budget' verbatim on budget rejection (plugin.py:305-313 bumps byte_budget_rejections and warns) — all three claims at docs/quickstart.md:23 match the code exactly.
